strings.jarvis.commandCenter.giveMeABigJobI2: Give me a mighty big job. I write th' plan, put together teams o' crew, hand out th' work in parallel, check what comes astern an' keep goin' until it's done, arr.
strings.jarvis.commandCenter.buildADarkModeToggl: Build a dark-mode toggle in th' ship's riggin' screen o' me active voyage, have a reviewer team check it an' sail th' tests. Don't avast until it works.
strings.jarvis.commandCenter.createTwoTeamsBuild: Create two teams: builders (Claude) ta implement an' reviewers (Antigravity) ta review an' test. Then fix all failin' tests in this voyage.

strings.jarvis.quickSettings.appliesFromTheNextT: Applies from th' next time th' microphone opens

strings.jarvis.quickSettings.nothingIsSentWhileY: Nary a thing be fired while ye think. Tap Fire, press th' headset button, or say one o' yer fire phrases.
strings.jarvis.quickSettings.longerWhenYouSoundU: Longer when ye sound unfinished (“…an'”), shorter fer short answers.

strings.jarvis.settings.offChatOnlyNoFloatingBut: Off = parley only: nay floatin' button, nay microphone, nary a thing read out loud. Ye use Jarvis in th' Jarvis parleys ye unfurl from th' parley list (Jarvis tab → Fresh Jarvis parley), by typin'.
strings.jarvis.settings.tapTheOrbToTalkLong: Tap th' orb ta talk, long-press it fer th' Jarvis panel (tasks, conversation, typin', quick switches). Ye can also type ta Jarvis: Jarvis tab in th' parley list → Fresh Jarvis parley.
strings.jarvis.settings.chatOnlyOpenTheJarvisTab: Parley only: unfurl th' Jarvis tab in th' parley list an' tap “Fresh Jarvis parley”. Pick its first mate an' parrot like in any parley.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisChatsInTheChatList: Jarvis parleys in th' parley list
strings.jarvis.settings.myJarvisChatsInAllToo: Me Jarvis parleys in All too
strings.jarvis.settings.allJarvisChatsInAllToo: All Jarvis parleys in All too
strings.jarvis.settings.everyJarvisChatTheVoiceC: Every Jarvis parley, th' voice parleys Jarvis opens by itself too, also shows in All an' th' first mate tabs.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisChatsAreListedOnly: Jarvis parleys be listed only under th' Jarvis tab. Th' work parleys Jarvis starts fer its tasks be normal parleys an' always show in All.
strings.jarvis.settings.pickTheAgentJarvisTalksT: Pick th' first mate Jarvis talks ta. Nary a thing be selected yet, so Jarvis can't answer.
strings.jarvis.settings.agenttitleIsTurnedOffInS: {agentTitle} be turned off in Ship's riggin' → Crew: turn it on, or pick another first mate here.
strings.jarvis.settings.theGrammaticalGenderJarv: Th' grammatical gender Jarvis uses fer itself. It matters in tongues like Hindi (“main kar rahi hoon” / “main kar raha hoon”). Pick a matchin' voice under Voice output.
strings.jarvis.settings.eGCallMeSantoshReply: e.g. Call me Santosh. Reply in Hinglish. I mostly work on th' Pico Dev voyage.
strings.jarvis.settings.sentWithTheFirstMessageO: Fired with th' first bottled message o' every fresh Jarvis parley. When ye change it (or th' persona), th' unfurl parley be told with yer next bottled message. Jarvis' own memory scribble (Ship's riggin' → Jarvis → Jarvis parley) be separate: Jarvis edits that one itself.
strings.jarvis.settings.turnOnJarvisFirstSetting: Turn on Jarvis first (Ship's riggin' → Jarvis).
strings.jarvis.settings.pickTheAgentJarvisTalksT: Pick th' first mate Jarvis talks ta first (Ship's riggin' → Jarvis → First mate).
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisReportedThatItsApp: Jarvis reported that its vessel tools be missin' in {agentTitle}. Add th' Jarvis MCP fort below (then weigh anchor a fresh Jarvis parley).
strings.jarvis.settings.requiredTheseAreTheTools: Required: these be th' tools Jarvis controls th' vessel with.
strings.jarvis.settings.n2LetJarvisToolsRunWitho: 2. Let Jarvis' tools sail without askin'
strings.jarvis.settings.notNeededTheGuideGoesWit: Not needed: th' guide goes with th' first bottled message.
strings.jarvis.settings.theFirstMessageOfEveryJa: Th' first bottled message o' every Jarvis parley carries th' whole guide an' th' list o' its tools with their parameters, so th' parrot acts at once instead o' searchin'. If th' Jarvis MCP fort be missin', Jarvis says so an' this card shows a ahoy, beware.
strings.jarvis.settings.heyJarvisOpenMyProjectSt: “Hey Jarvis, unfurl me voyage” starts starboard away. Common mishearings o' “Jarvis” count too. Th' wake phrase needs hands-free mode an' keeps th' device recognizer busy, which uses battery.
strings.jarvis.settings.keepsJarvisMicrophoneSer: Keeps Jarvis' microphone service runnin' so th' wake phrase an' th' headset button work with th' screen off or another vessel unfurl. A notification shows its state with Talk / Fire / Avast.
strings.jarvis.settings.withHandsFreeOnOnePress: With hands-free on: one press talks (or sends), two presses avast. Works while nay music vessel holds th' button.
strings.jarvis.settings.quickSettingsTilePullDow: Quick Ship's riggin' tile: pull down th' notification shade, edit th' tiles an' add “Jarvis” ta talk from anywhere with one tap. While Pico Dev runs in th' background it listens without openin' th' vessel.
strings.jarvis.settings.alsoLongPressThePicoDevI: Also: long-press th' Pico Dev icon → Jarvis, or put Jarvis on th' port screen.
strings.jarvis.settings.thisLauncherCantAddShort: This launcher can't add shortcuts. Long-press th' Pico Dev icon instead.
strings.jarvis.settings.youCanAlwaysSendWithThe: Ye can always fire with th' Fire button on th' card, th' headset button or th' notification's Fire.
strings.jarvis.settings.offNothingIsSentWhileYou: Off: nary a thing be fired while ye take a break ta think. Say a fire phrase or tap Fire when ye be done, arr.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisWaitsLongerWhenYou: Jarvis waits longer when ye sound unfinished (“…an'”, “…th'”) an' less fer short answers. Tap Hold fast ta keep talkin'.
strings.jarvis.settings.whenJarvisJustAskedYouSo: When Jarvis just asked ye somethin', yer answer be fired after th' pause above, even with auto fire off.
strings.jarvis.settings.answersAreSentExactlyLik: Answers be fired exactly like every last doubloon else. Th' fire mode be fixed when th' microphone opens an' never changes while ye talk.
strings.jarvis.settings.endWithOneOfTheseAnd: End with one o' these an' it be fired at once (th' phrase itself be not fired).
strings.jarvis.settings.endWithOneOfTheseAnd2: End with one o' these an' nary a thing be fired.
strings.jarvis.settings.aPhraseOnlyCountsAtThe: A phrase only counts at th' mighty end. “…an' fire it”, “…ta fire it”, “can ye do it” an' “don't fire it” stay part o' yer bottled message. Short or everyday phrases (“fire”, “over”, “do it”) only count when ye say them on their own after a short pause. When a phrase keeps firin' by mistake, toss overboard it or add a longer sentence instead (e.g. “jarvis fire it now”).
strings.jarvis.settings.afterJarvisSpeaksListenF: After Jarvis speaks, listen fer yer reply
strings.jarvis.settings.theMicrophoneOpensAfterE: Th' microphone opens after every answer while ye be talkin' ta Jarvis.
strings.jarvis.settings.theMicrophoneOnlyOpensWh: Th' microphone only opens when ye tap or wake Jarvis (an' when it asks ye somethin' it needs starboard away).
strings.jarvis.settings.ifYouSayNothingAtAll: If ye say nary a thing at all in this time, th' microphone closes with a soft tone.
strings.jarvis.settings.everythingHeardIsForJarv: Every last doubloon heard be fer Jarvis.
strings.jarvis.settings.duringFollowUpListeningJ: During follow-up listenin' Jarvis only reacts when ye say its name (or answer its question).
During follow-up listenin' Jarvis ignores what was clearly said ta someone else, an' filler like “um”.
strings.jarvis.settings.speakingWhileJarvisIsSti: Speakin' while Jarvis be still workin'
strings.jarvis.settings.tonesWhenTheMicrophoneOp: Tones when th' microphone opens an' closes
strings.jarvis.settings.thisDeviceUsesAndroidsRe: “This device” uses Android's recognizer an' needs nay sign-in. If th' agent's dictation fails, Jarvis switches ta th' device fer th' rest o' th' session.
strings.jarvis.settings.yourOwnPhrasesThatActAt: Yer own phrases that act at once, without askin' th' parrot, when ye say them on their own (optionally with “Jarvis” or “pray”). There be none until ye add them, so a plain “okay” or “avast” in a conversation always goes ta Jarvis like anythin' else.
strings.jarvis.settings.interruptJarvisWorkStart: Interrupt Jarvis' work (starts a bottled message)
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisShowsItsAnswersOnT: Jarvis shows its answers on th' card instead o' sayin' them (meetings, night). Also in quick ship's riggin' (tune icon).
strings.jarvis.settings.ifTheOnlineVoiceFailsJar: If th' online voice fails, Jarvis falls astern ta this device's voice.
strings.jarvis.settings.helloImJarvisThisIsHow: Ahoy, I'm Jarvis. This be how I sound.
strings.jarvis.settings.youCanAlsoSaySpeakSlower: Ye can also say “speak slower”, “faster” or “repeat that”: Jarvis handles those at once, without askin' th' parrot.
strings.jarvis.settings.sayBuildTheReleaseAndTel: Say “build th' release an' tell me when it's done, arr”: Jarvis starts a task in its own parley an' watches it. Ye can ask how it be goin', redirect it (“also sail th' tests”), avast it, or answer its questions by voice. Tasks be listed in th' Jarvis panel.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisReadsTheResultTell: Jarvis reads th' result, tells ye th' gist an' follows up (asks ye, passes answers on). Uses a parrot turn per event.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisJustAnnouncesItRel: Jarvis just announces it (“Release build be done, arr”), without a parrot turn.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisApprovesWhatClearl: Jarvis approves what clearly serves th' task's goal an' asks ye about anythin' risky or unclear (needs “Jarvis decides” above).
strings.jarvis.settings.approvalsFollowApprovals: Approvals follow “Approvals by voice” below: approved automatically or read out ta ye.
strings.jarvis.settings.reportATaskWithNoProgres: Report a task with nay progress after
strings.jarvis.settings.sayWhenAnyOtherChatFinis: Say when any other parley finishes
strings.jarvis.settings.chatTitleIsDonePleaseChe: “<parley title> be done, arr. Pray check it.” fer parleys that be not Jarvis tasks.
strings.jarvis.settings.notForTheChatImLooking: Not fer th' parley I'm lookin' at
strings.jarvis.settings.alsoReadTheStartOfThe: Also read th' weigh anchor o' th' reply
strings.jarvis.settings.forAnnouncementsWithoutA: Fer announcements without a parrot turn.
strings.jarvis.settings.warnWhenThe5HourUsage: Warn when th' 5-hour usage be almost gone
strings.jarvis.settings.oncePerWindowAtAbout15: Once per window, at about 15% port side (Claude Code).
strings.jarvis.settings.openTheJarvisTabInThe: Unfurl th' Jarvis tab in th' parley list an' tap “Fresh Jarvis parley” ta type ta Jarvis like in any parley. Give it a mighty big job: it writes a mission (goal, done, arr-when, steps), creates teams o' crew (e.g. builders an' reviewers), hands out tasks in parallel, checks what comes astern an' keeps goin'. Th' strip above th' input shows th' mission, th' teams' tasks an' th' switches below.
strings.jarvis.settings.readRepliesOutLoudInNew: Read replies out loud in fresh Jarvis parleys
strings.jarvis.settings.whenJarvisSleepsOrPollsW: When Jarvis sleeps or polls while waitin' fer its tasks
strings.jarvis.settings.stopItHandItTheNews: Avast it, hand it th' news
strings.jarvis.settings.noGuardNewsWaitsUntilJar: Nay guard: news waits until Jarvis ends its turn by itself.
strings.jarvis.settings.whateverComesInMeanwhile: Whatever comes in meanwhile, an' every last doubloon that finished while Jarvis was busy, goes ta it together in one bottled message.
strings.jarvis.settings.withAutopilotOnJarvisIsN: With autopilot on, Jarvis be nudged ta continue whenever it stops while th' mission be unfinished an' nary a thing runs. Nudges in a row without progress pause it.
strings.jarvis.settings.whetherJarvisChatsAlsoSh: Whether Jarvis parleys also show in All: Ship's riggin' → Jarvis, “Jarvis parleys in th' parley list”.
strings.jarvis.settings.everythingIsApprovedExce: Every last doubloon be approved except risky actions (scuttlin', pushin', installin' from th' web), which be read out first.
strings.jarvis.settings.nothingIsAskedUseOnlyIf: Nary a thing be asked. Use only if ye fully trust what th' crew do.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisReadsEachRequestOu: Jarvis reads each request out (“It wants ta sail th' command…”) an' waits fer yer aye or nay.
strings.jarvis.settings.approveEverythingAutomat: Approve every last doubloon automatically, matey?
strings.jarvis.settings.agentsWillRunCommandsEdi: Crew will sail commands, edit scrolls an' scuttle things without askin', includin' by mistake. Only choose this if ye accept that.
strings.jarvis.settings.letJarvisChangeAppSettin: Let Jarvis change vessel ship's riggin'
strings.jarvis.settings.whileItsActiveWhileJarvi: “While it's active”: while Jarvis listens, works or speaks, or a task runs. Runnin' parleys o' both crew keep th' screen on anyway.
strings.jarvis.settings.dragTheOrbAnywhereItRest: Drag th' orb anywhere: it rests on th' nearest edge. “Hidden” shows it only while Jarvis be active (use th' tile, headset or wake phrase).
strings.jarvis.settings.outsidePicoDevTheOrbFloa: Outside Pico Dev th' orb floats over any vessel: tap it ta talk, long-press it fer th' Jarvis panel. While Jarvis listens or speaks, its card shows at th' bilge o' th' screen. Drag th' orb onto th' ✕ at th' bilge ta hide it until ye talk ta Jarvis in Pico Dev again. Hidden during Antigravity voice calls.
strings.jarvis.settings.needsDisplayOverOtherApp: Needs “Display over other vessels” fer Pico Dev.
strings.jarvis.settings.aSlimStatusLineCheckingT: A slim status line (“Checkin' th' build…”) while it works.
strings.jarvis.settings.showWhatJarvisHeardAndSa: Show what Jarvis heard an' said
strings.jarvis.settings.sendLiveContextWithEvery: Fire live context with every bottled message
strings.jarvis.settings.screenProjectChatOnScree: Screen, voyage, parley on screen, tasks, approvals an' timers, so Jarvis rarely has ta look them up.
strings.jarvis.settings.startAFreshChatAfterIdle: Weigh anchor a fresh parley after idle time
strings.jarvis.settings.startAFreshChatAfterThis: Weigh anchor a fresh parley after this many bottled messages
strings.jarvis.settings.bothAreOffByDefaultSo: Both be off by default so Jarvis never forgets mid-task. A parley be only replaced when ye speak th' next bottled message, never while it be workin'. Ye can always say “weigh anchor again” or “fresh session”.
strings.jarvis.settings.aNewChatStartsWithThe: A fresh parley starts with th' Jarvis memory scribble an' th' last lines o' th' old conversation.
strings.jarvis.settings.theNextMessageStartsANew: Th' next bottled message starts a fresh Jarvis parley
strings.jarvis.settings.startAFreshChatNow: Weigh anchor a fresh parley now
strings.jarvis.settings.pIsAlreadyAOthernamePhra: “{p}” be already a {otherName} phrase. Toss overboard it there first.
strings.jarvis.settings.addedPIsShortOrCommon: Added. “{p}” be short or common, so it only counts when said on its own after a short pause.
strings.jarvis.settings.readingFilesAndSearching: Readin' scrolls an' searchin' be approved; anythin' else be read out an' needs a aye.
strings.jarvis.settings.policyJarvisOwnToolsNeve: {policy} Jarvis' own tools never need approval. Th' parley on screen be only handled while hands-free mode be on (tasks always be).
strings.jarvis.settings.aHandsFreeAssistantForTh: A hands-free assistant fer th' whole vessel: talk ta unfurl voyages an' scrolls, sail an' watch tasks, answer approvals, change ship's riggin', ask fer help, matey or yer usage. Off by default; nary a thing listens until ye turn it on.
strings.jarvis.settings.theJarvisChatsYouOpenedY: Th' Jarvis parleys ye unfurled yourself (Fresh Jarvis parley) also show in All an' th' first mate tabs; th' voice parleys Jarvis opens by itself stay under Jarvis.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisTalksToANormalHidd: Jarvis talks ta a normal hidden parley o' this first mate (hunt it under Jarvis in th' parley list). A swift parrot feels best fer voice; mighty big jobs sail as tasks in their own parleys.
strings.jarvis.settings.sentAfterAFixedPauseA: Fired after a fixed pause. A bar on th' card fills while it counts down; tap Hold fast ta keep talkin'.
strings.jarvis.settings.jarvisDecidesAfterDoneWa: Jarvis decides: after “Done, arr, want me ta sail it?” th' microphone opens; after “Stashed th' scroll.” it does not. Questions always unfurl it.

In a Jarvis parley (Jarvis tab), Jarvis manages th' sail: it starts every reviewer as a separate parley, shows th' phases as its mission steps an' asks ye ta approve th' design.
strings.settings.egm.whichOfEgmsReviewerPersonas: Which o' EGM's reviewer personas look at a design (/egm an' /egm-review). Each be a separate reviewer sail that costs tokens. /egm-lite always uses one reviewer.
strings.settings.egm.onYouSeeEveryStagesReport: On: ye see every stage's report before th' next stage runs. Off: all stages sail, then one combined report.

strings.settings.egm.eachRunningReviewerIsAFull: Each runnin' reviewer be a full first mate: more at once be faster but needs more memory.
strings.settings.egm.whoIsTheElephantWritesAnd: Who be th' Elephant (writes an' fixes th' design) when ye type an EGM command in a Jarvis parley. Th' reviewers be always separate parleys that Jarvis starts.
strings.settings.egm.whatEachCommandTellsTheAgen: What each command tells th' first mate after th' facts from this page (where EGM be, th' reviewers, th' limits). Edit it ta change how th' first mate or Jarvis runs EGM.

strings.settings.egm.whichCommandToUseWhenWith: Which command ta use when, with examples, an' what happens in a normal parley an' in a Jarvis parley.

strings.settings.egm.forSmallChangesABugFix: Fer wee changes: a bug fix, a refactor, a wee feature, a change ta a spec. Much cheaper than /egm.
strings.settings.egm.n1TheAgentFirstPointsOut:
1. Th' first mate first points out risks an' gaps in th' task, then waits.
2. Type checklist: it writes a short plan (egm_lite_checklist.md).
3. Type goldfish: one fresh reviewer checks th' plan (ye can skip this).
4. Type exec: it makes th' change.
5. Type review: one fresh reviewer checks th' changes.
strings.settings.egm.whenAPlanOrDesignDocument: When a plan or design document already exists (yers, or written in another parley) an' ye want it checked before anyone builds it.
strings.settings.egm.theReviewersCheckTheDocumen: Th' reviewers check th' document an' th' first mate writes their findings into a report. Then ye choose: th' first mate fixes th' findings, ye fix them yourself, or ye avast there.
strings.settings.egm.normalChatOrJarvisChat: Normal parley or Jarvis parley, matey?
strings.settings.egm.normalChatClaudeCodeCodexTh: Normal parley (Claude Code, Codex, …): th' first mate does every last doubloon in that parley an' runs th' reviewers as its own hidden sub-crew. Th' simplest an' lightest way. If th' first mate has nay sub-first mate tool, it stops an' tells ye ta use a Jarvis parley.
strings.settings.egm.jarvisChatJarvisTabAJarvis: Jarvis parley (Jarvis tab → a Jarvis parley, then type th' command): Jarvis manages th' sail. It starts a planner parley (or plans itself, see Jarvis below) an' one parley per reviewer, which ye can unfurl from th' parley list. Th' phases show as Jarvis' mission steps, an' Jarvis asks ye ta approve th' design. Use it ta watch th' reviewers, or when th' first mate has nay sub-first mate tool. Every reviewer parley be a full first mate, so it needs more memory.
strings.settings.egm.sentAfterTheRunsFactsEgms: Fired after th' run's facts (EGM's chest, th' planner an' reviewer goals, th' limits). It tells Jarvis how ta manage th' planner an' th' reviewer parleys.
strings.settings.egm.sentAfterTheRunsFactsEgms2: Fired after th' run's facts (EGM's chest, th' reviewers, th' limits). It tells th' first mate how ta sail th' reviewers in its own parley.
strings.settings.egm.googlesElephantGoldfishMode: Google's Elephant-Goldfish Parrot (unfurl source, Apache 2.0). Th' first mate (th' Elephant) works out a design with ye an' writes it down. Then fresh reviewers (th' Goldfish), who never saw yer conversation, read only th' document an' try ta break it. Th' design be fixed until it passes an' ye approve it; only then be code written.
strings.settings.egm.typeOneAtTheStartOf: Type one at th' weigh anchor o' a bottled message in any parley; th' rest o' th' bottled message be th' task.
strings.settings.egm.n1TheAgentAsksYouQuestions:
1. Th' first mate asks ye questions until th' idea be clear (brainstorm).
2. It writes th' design document, section by section, an' asks fer yer OK on each.
3. Th' reviewers attack th' document; th' first mate fixes it or explains why a findin' be wrong.
4. Ye approve th' design.
5. Only then does it write th' code.
strings.settings.egm.answerTheAgentsQuestionsItA:
• Answer th' agent's questions: it asks one at a time.
• Every last doubloon be stashed as scrolls in yer voyage, in {artifactDir}/<topic>/: th' design document an' every review report. Unfurl them in Scrolls.
• Nary a thing be coded before ye approve. Ta approve, just say so; or ask fer changes, or fer one more review round.
• Ye can avast at any time. Th' scrolls stay, an' later ye can check th' document again with /egm-review.
strings.settings.egm.startWithQuickOrStandardRev:
• Weigh anchor with Quick or Standard reviewers; Full runs eight reviewers in every round.
• If th' spyglass gets slow, set Reviewers at th' same time ta 1.
• Write th' task as ye would explain it ta a colleague: what, why, an' any limits ("nay fresh libraries").
• Fer a change o' a few lines, a plain parley be cheaper than EGM.

strings.settings.webViewExtensions.noPluginsInst: Nay plugins installed. Choose a ZIP containin' manifest.json plus a background worker, a skills/ chest, or both.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.thisIsBuiltIn: This be built into th' vessel: it be tossed overboard now an' comes astern when th' vessel restarts. Ta keep it off, disable it instead.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.thisDeletesTh: This deletes th' chest {dirPath} from yer scrolls. Make sure ye have another plunder if it be yer source.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.ifYouAddedItI: If ye added it in MCP ship's riggin', toss overboard that fort there too.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.alsoDeleteIts: Also scuttle its stored data (otherwise kept fer a reinstall)
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.aPluginAlread: A plugin already uses this chest name
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.thePluginsIdA: Th' plugin's ID an' stored data be preserved. Th' previous package be restored if loadin' fails.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.installedAsAS: Installed as a separate plugin next ta th' existin' one, with its own ID taken from this chest name. Add it ta MCP ship's riggin' separately.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.theZipMayCont: Th' ZIP may contain manifest.json directly or inside one enclosin' chest.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.enableOrInsta: Enable or install a plugin in Ship's riggin' → Custom Pico Dev Plugins first.
strings.settings.webViewExtensions.addAnEnabledP: Add an enabled plugin ta yer parrot in MCP ship's riggin' → Custom Pico Dev Plugin MCP; its skills come with it as get_skills / get_skill tools. In parley, type /plu: ta point th' parrot at a plugin or one o' its skills. Updatin' or reloadin' restarts that plugin's worker; its MCP connection an' stored data be kept.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.theDesktopRunsInPico: Th' desktop runs in Pico Dev's cannon deck. Install it in Ship's riggin' → Cannon deck & Shell, then come astern here.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.Pico DevsOwnBuildOfT: Pico Dev's own build o' Termux:X11, th' vessel that shows th' desktop. It runs inside Pico Dev, so Android keeps th' desktop runnin' at full speed while ye use it.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.thisTermuxX11DoesntS: This Termux:X11 doesn't divvy up Pico Dev's UID, so it can't sail inside Pico Dev. Uninstall it, then install it again.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.theOfficialTermuxX11: Th' official Termux:X11 be installed. It can't sail inside Pico Dev, an' Android won't install Pico Dev's build over it (they be signed differently). Uninstall it first, then install Pico Dev's build.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.notNeededInTheUbuntu: Not needed in th' Ubuntu chroot: Pico Dev starts th' X fort itself (from th' Termux:X11 vessel) an' shares its display with th' chroot.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.companionIsInstalled: {companion} be installed, but this Termux:X11 needs {neededCompanion}. Installin' replaces it.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.xfceIsAFullLightDesk: XFCE be a full, light desktop an' a fine place ta weigh anchor.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.lxqtIsALightQtDeskto: LXQt be a light Qt desktop.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.itComesFromUbuntuApt: It comes from Ubuntu (apt) an' runs in th' Ubuntu chroot as yer captain. A large haul aboard.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.itComesFromX11RepoAn: It comes from x11-repo an' be a large haul aboard.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.installsChromiumOrFi: Installs Chromium or Firefox in th' Ubuntu chroot from th' xtradeb/apps PPA (Ubuntu's own packages o' both be snaps, which do not sail in a chroot).
strings.settings.x11Desktop.installABrowserFromT: Install a crow's nest from tur-repo ta browse th' web on yer desktop.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.ifTheDesktopClosesBy: If th' desktop closes by itself
strings.settings.x11Desktop.android12AndNewerSto: Android 12 an' newer avast th' extra processes o' vessels once there be more than 32 in total. A desktop starts many, so Android may batten down it. Ye can turn this limit off once, over ADB. It stays off until ye turn it astern on or reset th' spyglass.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.connectTheTerminalsA: Board th' terminal's adb ta this spyglass first.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.runLinuxDesktopAppsA: Sail Linux desktop vessels (a crow's nest, an IDE, office vessels) from Pico Dev's cannon deck. Termux:X11 shows th' desktop.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.theDesktopRunsInside: Th' desktop runs inside Pico Dev, so Android won't slow it down or avast it while ye use it.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.n1InstallPicoDevTerm: 1. Install Pico Dev-termux-x11-sharedUid.apk an' haul aboard Pico Dev-termux-x11-*-all.deb from {fORK_RELEASES_PAGE}
strings.settings.x11Desktop.n3InstallTheTermuxX1: 3. Install th' termux-x11 command (in th' chest with th' .deb)
strings.settings.x11Desktop.n4UpdateYourPackages: 4. Refit yer packages, then install a desktop
strings.settings.x11Desktop.n5StartItThenOpenTer: 5. Weigh anchor it, then unfurl Termux:X11
strings.settings.x11Desktop.preferTheTerminalThe: Prefer th' cannon deck? These be th' same steps as commands.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.dontInstallTermuxX11: Don't install termux-x11-nightly from x11-repo: it only works with th' official Termux:X11, not Pico Dev's build.
strings.settings.x11Desktop.theTerminalPartTheTe: Th' cannon deck part: th' termux-x11 command that starts th' X fort. {neededCompanion} goes with {value}.

strings.voice.agyVoiceCallSettings.theVoiceCallT: Th' Voice call tile in Quick Ship's riggin' an' th' "Voice call" shortcut (long-press th' Pico Dev icon) call Antigravity in th' last parley that had a call, or a fresh parley th' first time. When Pico Dev be runnin' th' call starts without openin' it; otherwise th' vessel opens an' calls once th' fort be up. During a call, a tap on th' tile ends it.
strings.voice.agyVoiceCallSettings.toAddTheTileP: Ta add th' tile: pull down Quick Ship's riggin', tap th' pencil (edit) an' drag "Voice call" up.
strings.voice.agyVoiceCallSettings.whileACallRun: While a call runs an' Pico Dev be not on screen, th' call shows over other vessels: a panel on th' lower half o' th' screen with th' status (an' when th' first mate be workin'), th' voice's orb, live captions an' th' call's buttons. Minimize it (⌄ or drag it down) ta a wee circle ye can drag anywhere; tap th' circle ta unfurl th' panel again. Calls from th' tile or shortcut unfurl as th' panel; leavin' th' vessel during a call shows th' circle.
